endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: centerville_schwan_park_dock_aerial_20260918 centerville-schwan-park-dock: TECHE Project lists the official Bayou Teche National Paddle Trail dock at Schwan Park, 514 Parish Road 131, Centerville. Current Google Maps aerial imagery shows the public park-side landing reaching the Bayou shore at the selected point 29.760737,-91.419060. The previous point was about 253 feet from mapped-water geometry and 408 feet from the matched flowline. The exact coordinate is imagery-derived with 50-foot uncertainty, not a surveyed TECHE coordinate.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the exact named authoritative water-entry control (centerville_schwan_park_dock_aerial_20260918 centerville-schwan-park-dock) on Bayou Teche; the 112 ft named-flowline offset reflects incomplete or generalized NHD coverage, not a proposed coordinate move.
